dct_description_sm: With a better understanding of the overall benefits of nutrients present in the different country foods consumed in Nunavik, we will better orient public policies aiming to improve country food consumption and food security, promote Inuit culture, minimize the risks from environmental contaminant exposure and the emergence of obesity, diabetes and cardiovascular diseases in this population and across the Arctic. From this pilot project on health benefits of country foods, we developed a community-based intervention project as well as larger interdisciplinary research/intervention proposals.
